freeze.combat_clause: Passive only: pinned fight_ordinary(attacker, defender, capacity, defender_is_tower=True, attacker_morale=force accelerated retained morale flag, defender_morale=target morale), matching the pinned step candidate. Source current morale is supplemental and cannot replace the retained force flag. Attacker victory predicts owner incoming and surviving attacker vector; defender victory predicts owner unchanged and surviving defender vector. Unknown aura, production or simultaneous arrival must be explicit. No formula revision or production promotion.

formula.name: fight_ordinary
formula.attacker_morale: retained force.accelerated; unique pinned known-leg ETA inversion only when directly observed flag is absent
formula.defender_morale: target tower morale at before tick
formula.source_current_morale: supplementary context only; never substituted for force.accelerated

timeline.arrival: audit tick t+1; combat projection comparison
timeline.following: same-scope tick t+2; observed follow-up comparison only, not a combat forecast

verdict.next_step: Gather controlled evidence; this passive sample cannot support formula promotion.

interpretation.raw_formula_outcome: All 31 fights are passively scored from exact before-tick vectors, shield, target capacity, and the frozen morale inputs; raw matches retain contaminated cases.
interpretation.owner_proxy: Owner agreement is reported independently from surviving-vector agreement.
interpretation.following_observation: The t+2 comparison checks the observed state against the t+1 combat projection; it is not a full next-tick prediction and can include later world changes.
interpretation.force_continuation: AMBIGUOUS means a new-leg-compatible force is visible but physical genealogy is not established. DISAPPEARED means the original typed route signature is absent from a complete visible force census at that observation; it does not establish permanent consumption.
interpretation.capacity: The defender capacity owner/vector are the before-tick inputs. A predicted owner change leaves post-capture capacity downstream and unknown in this replay.
